entries.answer: HERE, NEXT BOSS, EVOLUTIONS and the DEX read the randomizer's POKéMON, teams, moves and items from the game itself. The gift and legendary POKéMON it moved aren't listed: the guide can't know them.
entries.title: This game is randomized

entries.answer: The MACH BIKE is the fast one - fast enough to cross cracked floors before they give way. The ACRO BIKE can hop and ride narrow rails. RYDEL in MAUVILLE CITY swaps one for the other.
entries.title: Two bikes

entries.answer: Trainers you've beaten can register you in the POKéNAV's MATCH CALL. Once you have five badges, walking around makes some of them want a rematch.
entries.title: Rematches

randomized.answer: Hold B to run once you have the RUNNING SHOES.
randomized.title: Running

entries.answer: Traded POKéMON obey up to Lv10 with no badges, Lv30 with the KNUCKLE BADGE, Lv50 with the HEAT BADGE, Lv70 with the FEATHER BADGE, and always with the RAIN BADGE.
entries.title: A traded POKéMON won't listen

entries.answer: Poison keeps hurting while you walk and can make a POKéMON faint. Cure it or heal at a POKéMON CENTER.
entries.title: Poison outside battle

randomized.answer: In this generation it's decided by the move's TYPE, not the move. FIRE, WATER, GRASS, ELECTRIC, ICE, PSYCHIC, DRAGON and DARK moves are special; NORMAL, FIGHTING, FLYING, POISON, GROUND, ROCK, BUG, GHOST and STEEL are physical.
randomized.title: Physical or special?

entries.answer: HM moves can't be forgotten normally. The MOVE DELETER in LILYCOVE CITY removes them.
entries.title: Getting rid of an HM move

entries.answer: The MOVE TUTOR in FALLARBOR TOWN teaches a forgotten move for one HEART SCALE.
entries.title: Relearning moves

randomized.answer: CUT: STONE. FLASH: KNUCKLE. ROCK SMASH: DYNAMO. STRENGTH: HEAT. SURF: BALANCE. FLY: FEATHER. DIVE: MIND. WATERFALL: RAIN. A POKéMON in the party must know the move too.
randomized.title: Which badge unlocks which HM?

randomized.answer: 500 steps per visit. You can't use your own POKéMON - throw POKéBLOCKS, then SAFARI BALLS.
randomized.title: How long do I have?

entries.answer: MR. STONE on DEVON CORP. 3F in RUSTBORO CITY, after you bring back the stolen DEVON GOODS.
entries.title: POKéNAV

entries.answer: RYDEL's bike shop in MAUVILLE CITY - pick the MACH or the ACRO BIKE.
entries.title: BIKE

entries.answer: A fisherman in DEWFORD TOWN.
entries.title: OLD ROD

entries.answer: A fisherman on ROUTE 118.
entries.title: GOOD ROD

entries.answer: A fisherman's house in MOSSDEEP CITY.
entries.hint: An island city in the east.
entries.title: SUPER ROD

entries.answer: Your rival gives it to you after your battle on ROUTE 110.
entries.title: ITEMFINDER

entries.answer: MR. STONE at DEVON CORP. 3F, once you've delivered his letter to STEVEN in GRANITE CAVE.
entries.title: EXP. SHARE

entries.answer: Your rival gives them to you in LAVARIDGE TOWN after you beat FLANNERY. The ROUTE 111 desert is closed without them.
entries.title: GO-GOGGLES

entries.answer: STEVEN on ROUTE 120, after the invisible POKéMON on the bridge.
entries.title: DEVON SCOPE

entries.answer: The PRETTY PETAL flower shop on ROUTE 104.
entries.hint: A shop between PETALBURG CITY and RUSTBORO CITY.
entries.title: WAILMER PAIL

entries.answer: The GLASS WORKSHOP on ROUTE 113. Walk through the falling ash to collect it.
entries.title: SOOT SACK

entries.answer: A woman in a MAUVILLE CITY house trades it for a HARBOR MAIL.
entries.title: COIN CASE

randomized.answer: MOM gives them to you in LITTLEROOT TOWN, on your way out after PROF. BIRCH hands you the POKéDEX.
randomized.title: RUNNING SHOES

entries.answer: Your rival, after your battle on ROUTE 119.
entries.title: HM02 FLY

entries.answer: WALLY's father in PETALBURG CITY, after you beat NORMAN.
entries.title: HM03 SURF

entries.answer: WANDA's boyfriend in RUSTURF TUNNEL, once you break the boulder there with ROCK SMASH.
entries.hint: The tunnel east of RUSTBORO CITY.
entries.title: HM04 STRENGTH

entries.answer: A hiker just inside GRANITE CAVE on DEWFORD's island.
entries.title: HM05 FLASH

entries.answer: The ROCK SMASH GUY in a MAUVILLE CITY house.
entries.title: HM06 ROCK SMASH

entries.answer: WALLACE in SOOTOPOLIS CITY, after the two ancient POKéMON are calmed.
entries.hint: Late in the story, SOOTOPOLIS CITY.
entries.title: HM07 WATERFALL

entries.answer: STEVEN at his house in MOSSDEEP CITY, after the SPACE CENTER.
entries.title: HM08 DIVE

randomized.answer: The CUTTER's house in RUSTBORO CITY.
randomized.title: HM01 CUT

entries.answer: A house in LILYCOVE CITY.
entries.title: MOVE DELETER

entries.answer: A house in FALLARBOR TOWN. Bring a HEART SCALE.
entries.title: MOVE TUTOR

randomized.answer: The TREASURE HUNTER's house on ROUTE 124 swaps shards found by DIVING: RED for a FIRE STONE, YELLOW for THUNDER, BLUE for WATER, GREEN for LEAF. Some lie around too: FIERY PATH (FIRE), ROUTE 119 (LEAF), NEW MAUVILLE (THUNDER), the ABANDONED SHIP (WATER), METEOR FALLS (MOON).
randomized.title: Evolution stones

entries.answer: The WEATHER INSTITUTE on ROUTE 119 gives it to you after you drive TEAM AQUA out.
entries.title: CASTFORM

entries.answer: An old woman in LAVARIDGE TOWN.
entries.title: WYNAUT (egg)

entries.answer: Pick the ROOT or CLAW FOSSIL at the top of the MIRAGE TOWER in the ROUTE 111 desert; DEVON CORP. 2F in RUSTBORO CITY revives it.
entries.title: LILEEP / ANORITH

entries.answer: STEVEN's house in MOSSDEEP CITY, after the HALL OF FAME.
entries.title: BELDUM

entries.answer: After the HALL OF FAME, catch every HOENN POKéMON (not JIRACHI or DEOXYS); PROF. BIRCH then lets you pick one.
entries.hint: Post-game, and a full HOENN DEX.
entries.title: CHIKORITA / CYNDAQUIL / TOTODILE

entries.answer: The top of the SKY PILLAR on ROUTE 131, once the story's SOOTOPOLIS CITY crisis is over. Some floors crack: ride the MACH BIKE across them.
entries.hint: A tower in the sea near PACIFIDLOG TOWN.
entries.title: RAYQUAZA

entries.answer: After the HALL OF FAME, a scientist at the WEATHER INSTITUTE reports a drought or heavy rain on some route. A drought leads to TERRA CAVE (GROUDON), heavy rain to MARINE CAVE underwater (KYOGRE, use DIVE).
entries.title: GROUDON / KYOGRE

entries.answer: First open the doors: put WAILORD first and RELICANTH last in your party and read the braille in the SEALED CHAMBER (DIVE on ROUTE 134). Then, after reading each ruin's braille: DESERT RUINS (ROUTE 111) - use ROCK SMASH; ANCIENT TOMB (ROUTE 120) - use FLASH; ISLAND CAVE (ROUTE 105) - walk one full lap along the walls.
entries.hint: It starts under the sea, with two particular POKéMON.
entries.title: REGIROCK / REGICE / REGISTEEL

entries.answer: After the HALL OF FAME, go home: a TV news flash asks the colour. RED makes LATIAS roam HOENN, BLUE makes LATIOS.
entries.title: LATIAS / LATIOS

entries.answer: Invisible ones sit on ROUTES 119 and 120 and in FORTREE CITY. The DEVON SCOPE reveals them.
entries.title: KECLEON

entries.answer: A TEAM AQUA grunt fled into RUSTURF TUNNEL, east of RUSTBORO CITY. Beat him there.
entries.title: Where are the stolen DEVON GOODS?

entries.answer: Your father NORMAN battles you once you have four badges.
entries.title: PETALBURG CITY's gym won't let me in

randomized.answer: MR. BRINEY sails you from his cottage on ROUTE 104 once you've rescued his PEEKO from TEAM AQUA in RUSTURF TUNNEL.
randomized.hint: An old sailor lost his pet.
randomized.title: How do I get to DEWFORD TOWN?

entries.answer: You need the GO-GOGGLES, from your rival in LAVARIDGE TOWN after the fourth badge.
entries.title: A sandstorm keeps pushing me back on ROUTE 111

entries.answer: It's a KECLEON. Get the DEVON SCOPE from STEVEN on ROUTE 120, then use it on the blocked spot.
entries.title: Something invisible blocks FORTREE CITY's gym

randomized.answer: They leave after the scene at METEOR FALLS - go north from MAUVILLE CITY on ROUTE 111, then west on ROUTE 113 to FALLARBOR TOWN and ROUTE 114.
randomized.title: TEAM MAGMA blocks the cable car on ROUTE 112

entries.answer: Calm the two ancient POKéMON first: WALLACE sends you to the SKY PILLAR on ROUTE 131.
entries.hint: Someone in SOOTOPOLIS CITY knows what to do.
entries.title: SOOTOPOLIS CITY's gym is closed

entries.answer: It's up a waterfall: you need HM07 WATERFALL (from WALLACE) and the RAIN BADGE.
entries.title: How do I reach EVER GRANDE CITY?

randomized.answer: It sits inside a crater: DIVE down on ROUTE 126 and surface inside.
randomized.title: How do I get into SOOTOPOLIS CITY?
